description: Reopen your lot to all visitors (default public mode). Prerequisite: caller must be the current lot's owner (VMTSOLotState.OwnerID == self). Effect: sets Lot_LotAdmitInfo.LotAdmitInfo_AdmitMode = 0 (admit-all) on the city DataService; fso_lots.admit_mode in the DB flips to 0. Cost: free. Idempotent. This verb uses mode=0 specifically; bypass values 1 (admit-list-only) and 2 (ban-list-only) are reached via admit-ban-lot list management.
